kids_evidence: Not a kids/families app. store/apps/VirtuBand.json:30 primary_category MUSIC; `grep -rn kidsAgeBand store/ratings` -> 0 hits; no KIDS category. store/ratings/VirtuBand.json has no kidsAgeBand. Spec user is a singer-songwriter or hobby musician (VirtuBand.md:45).

banner.where: lib/screens/library_screen.dart:120 (empty library) and :217 (end of the song list), via the app's own BannerAdSlot (lib/widgets/banner_ad_slot.dart:25)

interstitial.why: Not used: lib/services/ads_service.dart:21-22 says 'There is no interstitial (it used to fire after every saved take)', and grep for onTransition/Interstitial in lib/ finds 0 hits. Keep it out, because it interrupted recording (VirtuBand.md:191).

native.why: There is no content feed. The Library is the user's own songs (library_screen.dart:212-216, for-loop of SongCard), usually a short list. The Instruments screen (lib/screens/instruments_screen.dart:18-22) is a small fixed set of instruments. The spec bans ads on the song screen, the record sheet and instrument surfaces (VirtuBand.md:190).

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. There is no quota or premium tier, and ads_service.dart:89 says 'Deliberately no interstitial and no rewarded ads'. Bounce/export of a demo is free (lib/state/app_state.dart:869-887).

blockers: VirtuBand serves its banner through its own BannerAdSlot/AdIds on google_mobile_ads (pubspec.yaml:77, lib/services/ads_service.dart). It does not call AglAds.configure, so AglNativeAd/AglAds.showRewarded would not work without that. Not needed, since both are 'no'.
Spec founder Q3: the review notes say 'the iOS build shows no ads', and that has not been checked against the shipped binary (VirtuBand.md:307).
